title: Hyperbolic area of Fatou components and new proofs of no-wandering-domain theorems
summary: We give a new elementary proof of Sullivan's no-wandering-domain theorem for rational maps of degree at least two using hyperbolic area. We then develop this method further to prove that a transcendental entire function has no wandering Fatou components if its set of singular values is compact and all accumulation points of that set lie in the Fatou set. Neither proof uses quasiconformal techniques.
